task_objective: Check the Python execution environment and module visibility before changing a previously working script.

rius.description: Verify which Python interpreter and virtual/conda/IDE environment actually runs the script and whether it matches the previously working environment.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Verify which Python interpreter and virtual/conda/IDE environment actually runs the script and whether it matches the previously working environment.

rius.rationale: Checks environment selection without requiring one environment manager.

rius.description: Check whether the missing module is present in the active environment: verify an external dependency with the same interpreter, or establish that an expected local module file is present, rather than trusting an unrelated installation.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check whether the missing module is present in the active environment: verify an external dependency with the same interpreter, or establish that an expected local module file is present, rather than trusting an unrelated installation.

rius.rationale: Checks module availability separately from interpreter selection and search-path visibility; local and external modules are valid branches, and package installation is not mandatory.

rius.description: Check module search visibility, such as the launch working directory, local module location, import name or relevant path settings, for a change that hides the module.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check module search visibility, such as the launch working directory, local module location, import name or relevant path settings, for a change that hides the module.

rius.rationale: Retains the path/local-module branch without requiring every possible import-system test.

notes: E6 draft; frozen prompt corpus v0.3.1, protocol 0.3, annotation schema 0.2. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants retain yesterday's success, a module-not-found error and first environment-related checks. No package/module name, platform, IDE or installation change is specified. Boundaries: Interpreter selection, package availability and import-path visibility are distinct candidate causes, with none uniquely established. Local modules and third-party packages are both possible. No automatic global install, administrator privileges, package-manager preference or code rewrite. A local-module visibility check can explicitly rule a branch in or out without installing an unrelated package. Equivalent wording, scripts and numerals are accepted. Defeating contradictions override positive anchors; a refusal/non-answer scores 0 on every RIU. CHECK-01 is separate and can flag the same span as an RIU error.

task_checks.rule: Score 0 (flagged) for a material factual or operational assertion contradicted by the prompt or justified task knowledge, including materially wrong numeric values, directions or comparators and unsafe operational instructions; cite the response span. Score 1 (pass) if no such assertion is present. Pure omission or insufficient RIU fulfillment alone does not fail this check. CHECK-01 is orthogonal to RIU coverage: the same span can fail both an RIU and CHECK-01, and an RIU failure must not suppress this check.
